subject: The confession about this month's predictions
preview_text: Our community's numbers are in. You won't believe what they discovered. This changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I wasn't going to send this email. Seriously. The numbers from our user community this month are so insane, I almost kept them secret. But you need to see this.

Last month, Predictify users collectively analyzed 47,892 match predictions. The accuracy rate on Premier League score predictions? 72.3%. That's not a guess. That's a pattern. And the community's top 100 users spotted 314 value bets that bookmakers missed. The data doesn't lie—it's beating gut feelings into submission every single matchday.

This is why the 'Community Insights' tab in the app is now glowing. It's not just our AI talking. It's thousands of fans like you, cross-referencing player xG, defensive stats, and tactical history to find edges. The confidence scores you see? They're now weighted with real-world results from this exact community.

Open the app. Tap 'Community Insights' before the weekend fixtures drop. See where the smart money is moving right now. P.S. The users who check this tab weekly are 3x more likely to spot a winning bet before odds shift. That window closes fast.
